summary: Request for privileged extraction of production logs for compliance review — Engineering Data Access
description:
Issue summary: Security & Compliance team requests a time-limited export of production request/response logs to validate a customer data-handling exception.

Impact: Needed to complete a DPIA-style review and to respond to an incoming regulator probe for a customer using Redwood Private. No service changes required, but access is sensitive because logs may contain customer-provided prompts and potentially PII.

Background: Legal engaged Support to retrieve a sample set of full request/response pairs for May 2026 (production, us-east). The sample must include entries for one tenant (tenant_id: redwood-corp-237) across three peak days (2026-05-10 to 2026-05-12). The request originates from Compliance (Priya Mehta) with a formal evidence request.

Requested access and scope:
- Data scope: full HTTP access logs + application-level request/response payloads filtered by tenant_id redwood-corp-237.
- Time window: 2026-05-10 00:00 to 2026-05-12 23:59 UTC.
- Output format: gzipped JSONL with field-level metadata (timestamp, request_id, model, route, region).
- Redaction requirement: customer email addresses and session tokens should be redacted unless Legal indicates otherwise.
- Duration: One-time export; access artifacts retained via audit logs.

Approvals required: Security (Data Protection Officer), SRE for extraction plan, and Legal for redaction rules. Compliance has requested proof of redaction prior to wider distribution.

Proposed method: run a controlled extraction job on an isolated infra worker with read-only access to the log S3 prefix, write output to a pre-approved secure artifact bucket (s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/prod-exports/INT-4312/), and notify Compliance when ready. All actions will be executed by a short-lived role (assume-role) and recorded in CloudTrail and internal audit logging.

Acceptance criteria:
- Extraction completes with file checksum and file listing in ticket.
- Redaction verification performed and attested by Security.
- Artifact accessible only to: Priya Mehta (Compliance), Daniel Brooks (Legal), Marcus Li (SRE), and an internal reviewer from Security.

Notes: This is an internal-support request; no customer-facing ticket required unless the customer is to be notified by Legal.
comments: Priya Mehta (Compliance) 2026-03-10: Submitted formal evidence request; we need minimally privileged export to support a regulator Q, ETA for final deliverable is 2026-03-18.

Marcus Li (SRE) 2026-03-11: Can perform extraction but need clarification on exact S3 prefixes and whether the application-level payloads are stored encrypted with customer-managed keys. Requesting a runbook approval and jumpbox account for execution.

Aisha Khan (Security) 2026-03-12: Security ok with a time-limited assume-role if we can guarantee redaction pipeline before distribution. Please confirm if PII detection will be automated or manual sampling used.

Riley Thompson (Reporter) 2026-03-12: Redaction plan: automated regex heuristics for common PII (emails, credit card patterns) + manual spot-check of a 0.5% sample. Legal to advise on whether to include or redact client identifiers beyond email.
Daniel Brooks (Legal) 2026-03-13: Legal requests that client billing identifiers be redacted. Also, we need a chain-of-custody note in the ticket before delivering artifacts to external counsel.

Marcus Li (SRE) 2026-03-14: Extraction job scheduled for 2026-03-16 with STS assume-role and artifact bucket s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/prod-exports/INT-4312/. Will attach runbook and job logs to ticket when complete.
investigation_notes: Initial checks: confirmed logs for tenant redwood-corp-237 exist in s3://prod-logs/us-east/2026/05/10-05/ and application payloads are present. Retention window includes requested dates. Encryption: server-side KMS (aws/rwd-platform); no CMK per-tenant detected. PII surface: sample scan (n=100) found 3 instances of email addresses and 1 possible personal name in payloads. Hypotheses: payloads may include customer-sent identifiers in prompts; redaction necessary prior to sharing. SRE to confirm extraction performance impact (expected ~2 hours, 25GB output).
resolution_notes: Pending: Security approval for redaction rules and Legal sign-off on which fields to redact (emails and billing IDs are marked for redaction). Next steps: SRE to run extraction on 2026-03-16 (job id will be attached), Security to perform automated redaction run and produce checksum before manual sampling, Legal to confirm chain-of-custody wording. Once artifacts are produced and verified, Compliance will download from the secured evidence bucket. Close ticket after artifact delivery and audit confirmation. Follow-up task: create a short runbook for future similar requests (INT-XXXX) and consider an automated, auditable redaction pipeline.
